messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — scheduling a late-evening preflight perf run for release v2.37.0. Need a gating decision by 21:30 UTC. Can folks run the micro-bench and paste p50/p95/p99? Thanks.

mira: Which variant should we target — stable-prod or canary-kernel?

alex: Run against canary-kernel-2 with seq_len=256, batch=8. Command: ```./bench.sh --model rwd-v2 --seq 256 --batch 8 --iters 200```

tony: Kicking it off now, will post numbers in ~20m.

release-bot: perf-job queued — id:8732; runner: gpu-cluster-5; ETA ~18m.

sam: FYI if p99 > 300ms we automatically consider rollback plan A (per runbook).

kevin: Quick reminder: attach flame or kernel-alloc logs if you see memory jitter.

mira: Results (canary-kernel-2, seq=256,batch=8): p50=45ms p95=210ms p99=430ms. Mem looks stable. Flame snapshot: ```top: attention -> kv_cache -> softmax```

alex: Hmm p99=430ms > our soft threshold of 400ms. Regression vs baseline?

mira: Baseline (yesterday, stable-prod): p99=380ms for same bench. So +50ms on p99.

tony: Notable uptick in sys CPU time during token loop. Filing quick profiler ticket: #PR-5489, attaching perf.map.

anya: Decision needed — can we tolerate +50ms for p99 for this rollout? Context: this is a minor rollout with behavioral fix. My take: if p99 <= 450ms and error rates are flat, allow incremental ramp. Otherwise hold.

alex: Agree with Anya. Ops, can we enable a fallback to stable-prod if we see customer impact?

release-bot: Canary routing rule created: fallback -> stable-prod on error-rate > 0.5% OR p99 > 500ms.

sam: Given p99=430ms and no error delta, +1 to proceed. Recommend ramp 10% -> 30% over 30m and watch metrics.

kevin: I'll set a temporary alert: p99 > 480ms -> paging to eng-oncall; dashboards linked.

mira: I'll re-run longer-seq test (seq=1024, batch=1) in ~15m to sanity-check tail behavior.

alex: Plan: ramp 10% now, hold for 15m. If no regressions and no errors, continue to 30%. Recording this thread as approval.

release-bot: Note logged: rollforward scheduled at 21:50 UTC if no veto.
